basic_details.job_title: ICGEB Research Scientist I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Structural Parasitology laboratory of the International Centre for Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology (ICGEB), New Delhi, has two Research Scientist-I positions on a DBT-sponsored research project on Genomics and NGS. The fellowship is as per DBT/DST/ICMR norms for RS-I. Applicants need a Doctoral degree in Science, or a Master's degree in Life Sciences or any sciences with experience in genome sequencing, NGS and analysis. They apply by email to [email protected] with a CV, three referees and a cover letter by 30 November 2026.

how_to_apply: The notice asks for applications by email only. It prints no application form or fee, and no email subject line.
Prepare a CV of not more than 3 pages that elaborates your research experience in detail.
Prepare the contact details of three academic referees: name, affiliation, e-mail and phone numbers.
Email all three documents to [email protected] on or before 30 November 2026.
important_instructions: The working station is the ICGEB campus, New Delhi. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted, and only by email. The interview is online only.

Fellowship as per DBT/DST/ICMR norms for RS-I

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: For Research Scientist-I (2 positions), applicants must hold a Doctoral degree in Science or a Master's degree in Life Sciences or any sciences, but with experience in genome sequencing, NGS and analysis, from a recognized university or equivalent. They must also demonstrate relevant research experience. Candidates must meet the required experience criteria to apply. Those lacking the essential qualifications will not be considered for the position.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The notice states the pay as a fellowship as per DBT/DST/ICMR norms for RS-I. It prints no rupee amount and does not state the tenure of the project.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICGEB Research Scientist-I
content_sections.text: The notice asks for applications by email only. It prints no application form or fee, and no email subject line. Prepare a CV of not more than 3 pages that elaborates your research experience in detail. Prepare the contact details of three academic referees: name, affiliation, e-mail and phone numbers. Write a one-page cover letter. Email all three documents to [email protected] on or before 30 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted via email with further details regarding the interview. The mode of interview is online only. The notice does not state an interview date or the basis of shortlisting.

content_sections.text: The working station is the ICGEB campus, New Delhi. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted, and only by email. The interview is online only.
